author: Bethesda Softworks
description:
Embark on the next set of adventures arriving in Season One of The Elder Scrolls Online. Solve the perplexing puzzles of the Nowhere Vault, listen for rumors and uncover hidden stories across Tamriel, and battle above and below the depths during the limited-time High Seas of Tamriel event (live from September 30 until October 14).

The Elder Scrolls Online Season One is now live until October 21 and is free for all ESO players.
